expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The reply gives the steps that bring receipts back: check and start the larder-worker service, and confirm through
the waiting jobs in procrastinate_jobs that the receipts go out.
expectations.evidence: The reply instructs checking 'systemctl status larder-worker', counting jobs via 'psql larder -c "select status, count(*) from procrastinate_jobs group by status"', starting with 'sudo systemctl start larder-worker', and waiting ~1 minute while repeating the queue check 'until both todo and doing are zero or absent', plus escalation via 'journalctl -u larder-worker -n 50' and contacting Tomás if the worker stops again — covering all required steps.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The reply names both the larder-worker service and the procrastinate_jobs table.
